name: ingested_at
description: Crawler-injected ingest timestamp, format YYYY-MM-DD_HH_MM. NULL for legacy data that predates the crawler.

fields.name: Station
fields.description: One element per weather station observed in this snapshot (CWA O-A0003-001).

fields.name: StationId
fields.description: CWA station ID. Alphanumeric (e.g. '466920' or 'C0R860'). 46 prefix = manned, C0/C1 prefix = automatic, others = agricultural.

fields.name: DateTime
fields.description: Observation timestamp, ISO-8601 with +08:00 offset (Asia/Taipei).

fields.name: CountyCode
fields.description: 縣市代碼 (e.g. '10013', '63000'). Stored as STRING to preserve administrative-ID semantics.

fields.name: StationAltitude
fields.description: Station altitude in meters. Static metadata; no sentinels per spec.

fields.name: CoordinateFormat
fields.description: Always 'decimal degrees' per spec.

fields.name: CoordinateName
fields.description: WGS84 or TWD67.

fields.name: WeatherElement
fields.description: Measurement fields. All numeric values stored as STRING to preserve CWA sentinel codes ('X' instrument fail, 'T' trace, '-99' missing, '-98' no rain in 6h, '990' calm wind). dbt staging translates them to FLOAT64 with separate raw + cleaned columns.

fields.name: AirTemperature
fields.description: Air temperature in °C. Sentinels: 'X' (instrument fail), '-99' (missing).

fields.name: AirPressure
fields.description: Station pressure in hPa. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: RelativeHumidity
fields.description: Relative humidity in %. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: WindSpeed
fields.description: Mean wind speed in m/s. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: WindDirection
fields.description: Mean wind direction in degrees. Sentinels: 'X', '-99', '990' (calm wind, undefined).

fields.name: SunshineDuration
fields.description: Sunshine duration in hours (10-min bucket). Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: UVIndex
fields.description: UV index. Spec says integer but legacy data has decimals. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: Weather
fields.description: Cloud cover + weather phenomenon (e.g. '晴', '多雲有雨'). Spec lists no sentinel codes; defensive cleaning treats 'X' / '-99' as NULL.

fields.name: VisibilityDescription
fields.description: Visibility category (e.g. '>30'). Spec lists '-99' as missing; defensive treatment also catches 'X'.

fields.name: Precipitation
fields.description: Current precipitation in mm. Sentinels: 'X' (instrument fail), 'T' (trace, ~0), '-99' (missing), '-98' (no rain in past 6 hours).

fields.name: PeakGustSpeed
fields.description: Peak gust speed in m/s. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: DateTime
fields.description: Time the peak gust occurred (ISO-8601). STRING to avoid auto-cast issues; downstream parses as needed.

fields.name: WindDirection
fields.description: Wind direction at peak gust in degrees. Sentinels: 'X', '-99', '990' (calm).

fields.name: Max10MinAverage
fields.description: Highest 10-minute average wind today. Currently NOT surfaced in our flat bronze observations table; available in raw JSON.

fields.name: WindSpeed
fields.description: Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: DailyExtreme
fields.description: Daily high/low temperature. Currently NOT surfaced in our flat bronze observations; available in raw JSON.

fields.name: AirTemperature
fields.description: Daily high temperature °C. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.

fields.name: AirTemperature
fields.description: Daily low temperature °C. Sentinels: 'X', '-99'.
